'''Cocoa beans''' are a raw [[ingredient]] whose [[intrinsic]] is {{EffectLink|Haste}}. They can't be eaten raw; roasted into [[chocolate]] they grant Haste for {{Value|Chocolate|duration|effect=Haste}}, and chocolate makes [[Chocolate Chip Cookie|chocolate chip cookie]]s (Haste, {{Value|Chocolate Chip Cookie|duration|effect=Haste|format=clock}}) and [[brownie]]s (Haste {{Value|Brownie|level|effect=Haste}}, {{Value|Brownie|duration|effect=Haste|format=clock}}).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/chocolate.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

Picking up cocoa beans unlocks the chocolate recipe. Raw cocoa beans are also used in [[Carrot Cupcake|carrot cupcake]]s, [[Golden Carrot Cupcake|golden carrot cupcake]]s and, instead of sunflowers, to press [[oil]].
